name: Toll the Dead

targets.description: One creature you can see within range.

cantrip_scaling.text: If the target is missing any Hit Points the dice are d12s instead: 1d12, then 2d12 at level 5, 3d12 at level 11, 4d12 at level 17.

summary: Wis save or 1d8 Necrotic damage, or 1d12 if the target is missing any Hit Points.
text: Point at one creature you can see within range; a single mournful bell chime sounds, audible within 10 feet of it. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure it takes 1d8 Necrotic damage, or 1d12 Necrotic damage instead if it is missing any of its Hit Points. The number of dice becomes two at character level 5 (2d8 or 2d12), three at level 11 and four at level 17.
